counters.cache_hits: repeat requests served from the in-run cache; reported, never charged
counters.evaluation_attempts_charged: every call that reaches the evaluator, VALID or not
counters.fresh_evaluator_attempts: those that actually built a vehicle and ran a solve
counters.unique_task_design_labels: distinct (task, design) pairs with a VALID label
counters.vlm_inner_solves_actual: inner VLM solves performed, reported separately and never counted as budget units

R_reserve.counting_rule: spent only against a recorded failure, never pre-assigned

S0_repair_and_calibration.buys: backend repair, zero-physics tests, lattice calibration, BO smoke
S0_repair_and_calibration.counting_rule: every calibration evaluation of a real deck

S1_meta_training.counting_rule: charged attempts; the 24x256 grid is the full charge

S2_meta_test.counting_rule: charged attempts on the held-out tasks

S3_model_selection.buys: 4 val tasks x 3 methods x 4 repeats x 64 designs
S3_model_selection.counting_rule: charged attempts of the frozen comparison

S4_online_bo.buys: 12 new test tasks x 10 paired repeats x 3 arms x 192 evaluations
S4_online_bo.counting_rule: the dominant spend; 16 init + up to 176 BO candidates per arm-task-repeat

S5_baseline_optimisers.buys: DE/PSO: 2 backends x 4 tasks x 3 repeats x 3 sampling methods x 128 evaluations
S5_baseline_optimisers.counting_rule: charged attempts of the classical baselines

S6_final_report.buys: final geometry recheck, statistics and cost report
S6_final_report.counting_rule: charged attempts of the closing audit

unit: one charged evaluation attempt of one design under one task, one backend and one lattice, including attempts that fail
